description: Search PIPD's fact-checked answers to common claims and myths about Palestine and Israel; use it for any question about such a claim. Returns the closest matching claims, best first, each with PIPD's full answers, sources and page URL, or an empty list with a note when nothing matches.

limit.description: Most claims to return, 1 to 5. Default 3.

query.description: The claim or question, in the user's words (English works best).

name: search_claims

answers.description: PIPD's answers to the claim, in markdown.

claim.description: The claim or myth, as PIPD phrases it.

match.description: search_claims only: strong when the score is at least 0.70.

sources.description: PIPD's sources, as markdown citations with links.

url.description: The claim's page on PaliAnswers. Cite and link it.

title: Search PaliAnswers claims
